name: GREENYB
recent: GREENYB 近期有多项股权变动：董事 Voon Sze Lin 在公开市场增持股份，同时公司因不可赎回可转换优先股转换而发行约1195万新股。此外，公司也进行了股份回购，并有多位大股东及董事的权益申报。
notable: 董事 Voon Sze Lin 在公开市场增持股份。
不可赎回可转换优先股转换为约1195万新股，并于2026年10月2日上市。
risks: 优先股转换导致新股发行，可能造成股权摊薄。
董事在闭门期内有交易意向。

events.what_en: Listing of new shares from preference share conversion

recent_en: GREENYB has seen several equity changes recently: Director Voon Sze Lin acquired shares in the open market, while the company issued about 11.95 million new shares from the conversion of irredeemable convertible preference shares. The company also conducted a share buyback and there were several substantial shareholder and director interest filings.
notable_en: Director Voon Sze Lin acquired shares in the open market.
Irredeemable convertible preference shares were converted into about 11.95 million new shares, listed on 2 Oct 2026.
The company conducted a share buyback.
risks_en: Conversion of preference shares led to new share issuance, which may cause dilution.
Directors indicated intention to deal during the closed period.
